name: meteo-platform
description: The meteo by Azohra platform's workspace shell: orchestration for the six published packages - @azohra/meteo.core, @azohra/meteo.briefing, @azohra/meteo.station, @azohra/meteo.grib, @azohra/meteo.j2k, and @azohra/meteo.forecast (the engine) - and the site. Nothing publishes from here - the packages are the atoms; this repo is the platform.
author: Justin Watts
